summary: work_package_hij2_handoff.zip was intentionally constructed as a source-code and evidence package excluding data/ir_shards/*.json. The 150 J.2-modified shards (143 from migrate_hij2_shards.mjs + 7 additional shards from targeted MOVE_CORE/EXHAUST sync) remain in the workspace under data/ir_shards/ and are pinned by SHA-256 and byte size in data/per_shard_validation_inventory.json and changed_shard_manifest.json.
reproducibilityAndVerificationSteps: 1. Verify workspace data/ir_shards/ against data/per_shard_validation_inventory.json and reports/work_package_hij2_1/changed_shard_manifest.json.
2. Run `node scripts/validate_514_shards_exhaustive.mjs` (verifies all 514 shards, 15,398 cards, 36,422 abilities, 34,855 unique physicalIds, 18,496 unique semanticIds, 0 collisions).
3. Run `node --test tests/data_audit.test.js` (verifies cards_index.json, cards_detailed.json, and 514 IR shards).
